title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-1rnj: std-only finalize passes &u64 instead of u64 to Ack::new
description:
Commit 849d6049 changed `window_bitmap` from `Vec<bool>` to `u64` and updated two `Ack::new` call sites (lines 1237, 1253), but missed the third at line 1280 in `finalize()`.

Line 1252: `let bitmap = self.window_bitmap(self.all1_window);` returns `u64`.
Line 1253: `Ack::new(..., bitmap, false);` — correct.
Line 1280: `Ack::new(..., &bitmap, true);` — WRONG, passes `&u64` instead of `u64`.

```rust
error[E0308]: mismatched types
    --> lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs:1280:25
     |
1280 |                         &bitmap,
     |                         ^^^^^^^ expected `u64`, found `&u64`
```

Fix: change `&bitmap` to `bitmap` on line 1280.
This only affects the `std` feature build path (cfg-extended `FragmentReceiver`).
